text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 4 Delroy Drive.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed Items 4, 5, 10 and 11 of the Order to Comply, dated May 6, 2019, regarding the property located at 4 Delroy Drive. 2. Confirmed Items 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, 14 and 15 of the Order to Comply, dated May 6, 2019, regarding the property located at 4 Delroy Drive, and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 30, 2020.
